articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of a coherent receiver that visualizes longitudinal signal power profile over multiple spans out of its incoming signal
abstract: We propose and demonstrate the world's first class of coherent receiver that can recognize distance-wise instantaneous optical power throughout an end-to-end optical path. This in-situ power profile monitoring can simultaneously localize multiple anomaly points caused by unexpected optical losses.

articleTitle: Real-time transmission of 240×200-Gb/s signal in S+C+L triple-band WDM without S- or L-band transceivers
abstract: Real-time S+C+L triple-band WDM transmission of coherent 200-Gb/s (34-Gbaud DP-16QAM) signals is demonstrated for the first time. With wide-band wavelength converters, 100-nm wavelength range (1504.98–1606.82 nm) transmission over 40 km is realized without a transceiver operating at S- or L-band.

articleTitle: 41-Tbps C-band transmission with 10-bps/Hz spectral efficiency using 1-Tbps 96-GBd PS-256QAM for DCI
abstract: Net rate of 1-Tbps/λ with a spectral efficiency of 10-bps/Hz is generated by maximizing achievable information rate with baud rate optimization and probabilistically shaped (PS) signal. A C-band WDM transmission over 100-km with 41-WDM 96-GBd PS-256QAM signals in 100-GHz grid is successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: Phase noise robust optical heterodyne system for reduced complexity millimeter-wave analog radio-over-fibre
abstract: Strict optical linewidth/coherence requirements for A-RoF systems are overcome through development of an analog optical heterodyne architecture tolerant to phase noise and carrier offset. Successful generation and reception of a 60GHz UF-OFDM signal using two free-running tunable lasers, without digital phase/frequency offset compensation, is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Multi-core fibers for data center applications
abstract: We present and review the multi-core fiber (MCF) technologies suitable for data center applications. We also present the potential use cases of the MCFs, and discuss the benefits from MCFs in these applications.

articleTitle: Beyond 200 Gb/s PAM4 transmission using Tomlinson-Harashima precoding
abstract: We show experimental results for the transmission of up to 112 Gbaud PAM4 comparing the performance of Tomlinson-Harashima precoding with decision-feedback equalization. Measurements for different symbol rates and fibre lengths of 1 km and 2 km are shown.

articleTitle: Increasing achievable information rates with pilot-based DSP in standard intradyne detection
abstract: Information rates of up to 17.4 b/4D-symbol and 15.9 b/4D-symbol were achieved at 15 GBd and 30 GBd, with pilot overhead of less than 5%. Information rates exceed previous results with 8-bit DACs while symbol rates were doubled.

articleTitle: PON standardisation status and future prospects
abstract: This paper reviews the status and way forward for PON standardization. Building upon the huge success of G-PON, and its evolution to XG-PON, the industry is busy in developing the next generation of PON systems, which serve diverse applications and include a vanety of technologies.

articleTitle: Field trial of multi-node, coherent-one-way Quantum Key Distribution with encrypted 5×100G DWDM transmission system
abstract: We report on the launch of a link using Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) integrated with 500Gbps encrypted data over 121 km between Adastral Park and Cambridge, UK. This is the first field trial of a Coherent-One-Way QKD system integrated with a commercial-grade encrypted DWDM system.

articleTitle: Demonstration of distributed radiofrequency signal processing on heterogeneous multicore fibres
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate for the first-time to our knowledge distributed radiofrequency signal processing performed by a heterogeneous multicore fibre link. A trench-assisted 7-core fibre, where each core presents a different chromatic dispersion behaviour, is custom-engineered to operate as a 2D sampled true time delay line.

articleTitle: Machine learning assisted EDFA gain ripple modelling for accurate QoT estimation
abstract: Wavelength dependent EDFA gain ripple has an impact on connection's OSNR performance. We propose a machine learning regression model to estimate the end to end gain ripple penalty and to increase QoT estimation accuracy.

articleTitle: SSBI-free 1024QAM single-sideband direct-detection transmission using phase modulation for high-quality analog mobile fronthaul
abstract: We propose a signal-to-signal beat interference (SSBI)-free analogue transmission scheme using PM in SSB-DD systems. This enables DSP-free optical field reconstruction of the PM signal. An IF-over-fibre transmission of eight 250-MHz OFDM signals with highest QAM order of 1024 is achieved, for the first time.

articleTitle: Extension of SNR droop model for constant output power amplifier systems
abstract: We present an extended version of a general droop model for signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) calculation within the framework of the Gaussian noise model for coherent transmission systems operating with constant output power optical amplifiers. The model includes signal-dependent noise generated by optical crosstalk.

articleTitle: Neural-network-based pre-distortion method to compensate for low resolution DAC nonlinearity
abstract: We evaluate the effect of digital to analogue converters (DACs) nonlinearity in transceivers based on low resolution DACs. A pre-distortion technique based on indirect learning neural networks is proposed which shows a 3.8dB improvement with high nonlinearity for 32Gbaud 64-QAM.

articleTitle: Demonstration of structural vibration sensing in a deployed PON infrastructure
abstract: We demonstrate the possibility of using a deployed Passive Optical Network (PON) infrastructure for structural vibration monitoring for smart city applications and simultaneously downstream 10Gbit NRZ transmission. The impact of PON trunk fibre backscattering noise on sensing system performance is experimentally assessed.

articleTitle: A compact integrated LAN-WDM EML TOSA for 400 Gbit/s ethernet over 10 km reach
abstract: We demonstrated a 400 Gb/s PAM4 signal transmission over SMF with 10 km with no penalty using a newly developed compact integrated LAN-WDM EML TOSA employing a stripline with an aperture on a FPC enabling to reduce an electrical crosstalk and miniaturize the TOSA.

articleTitle: Linear and nonlinear noise monitoring in coherent systems using fast BER measurement and neural networks
abstract: Application of fast (10ns–1μs) BER histogram measurement to joint monitoring and separate linear and nonlinear noise-to-signal ratio calculation using a neural network is proposed. This method is experimentally validated on a 40-channel 1000-km SSMF link and shown to yield less than 5 percent normalized estimation error.

articleTitle: Accurate indoor localization for beam-steered OWC system using optical camera
abstract: Using a low-cost optical camera, we demonstrated an accurate and fast localization technique for ultra-high capacity beam-steered optical wireless communication. Multiple user devices have been localized simultaneously within 25ms for less than 5mm accuracy at a reach beyond 3m.

articleTitle: A Raman-aware enhanced GN-model to estimate the modulation format dependence of the SNR tilt in C+L band
abstract: By including the inter-channel stimulated Raman scattering in the enhanced Gaussian noise model we show that the modulation format has an impact on the Raman-induced tilt on the signal-to-noise ratio of ultra-wideband optical transmissions.

articleTitle: Towards broadly optimum multi-core fiber designs
abstract: We show that key multi-core fiber (MCF) design parameters depend only weakly on the application scenario, from data-center interconnects to submarine links, leading to transmission-distance-independent optimum MCF designs. We analyse the dependence of the optimum MCF core count on fiber diameter and effective core area.

articleTitle: Equalization of soliton transmission based on nonlinear Fourier transform using neural networks
abstract: We show the equalization of nonlinear Fourier transformation coefficients using neural networks. Correlations between noise-induced distortions of eigenvalues and their coefficients can be used to reduce the impact of distributed noise on b-modulated solitons. Reach extensions of around 3,000 km were observable in simulations.

articleTitle: Rate optimization using SO(4) transforms for PDL mitigation
abstract: SO(4)-based polarization codes are described in order to increase PDL-resilience in coherent transmissions. A 2-parameter optimization allows to maximize the minimal information rate achieved by discrete Pol-Mux QAM transmissions. The new optimal polarization code shows an increased capacity compared to the recently proposed Spatially-Balanced scheme.

articleTitle: Potential system impact of low-loss antiresonant hollow core fibers
abstract: Recent Anti-Resonant Hollow-Core Fiber (ARHCF) prototypes have shown a steady decrease in loss. Theoretical predictions indicate that they could eventually outperform conventional fibers, both for loss and optical bandwidth. In this paper we investigate the potential impact of hypothetical high-performance ARHCFs on long-haul optical communication systems.

articleTitle: Demonstration of spatial channel networking using two types of hierarchical optical cross-connects
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time, the feasibility of spatial channel networking including spatial bypassing, spectral grooming, spatial-lane change, and spatial-channel protection over a spatial channel network testbed that comprises two types of low-loss space/wavelength-hierarchical optical cross-connect prototypes connected with four-core fibers.

articleTitle: Provisioning in multi-band optical networks: A C+L+S-band use case
abstract: Multi-band optical transmission promises to extend the lifetime of currently deployed networks. We propose a provisioning scheme tailored for multi-band systems. We show how it attains a considerable reduction of the blocking probability, despite GSNR penalties in C-band, achieving a fourfold increase in accommodated traffic.

articleTitle: An ultra-fast method for gain and noise prediction of Raman amplifiers
abstract: A machine learning method for prediction of Raman gain and noise spectra is presented: it guarantees high-accuracy (RMSE < 0.4 dB) and low computational complexity making it suitable for real-time implementation in future optical networks controllers.

articleTitle: Coded modulation using a 512-ary Hurwitz-integer constellation
abstract: A signaling scheme is presented which effectively combines a class of power-efficient four-dimensional modulation formats with forward error correction using a tailored two-stage coded modulation scheme. In a 400ZR system experiment, a 0.8-dB gain in required OSNR over DP 16-QAM at 60 GBd is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Analysis and optimisation of distribution matching for the nonlinear fibre channel
abstract: Enhanced Gaussian noise models are used to demonstrate that the per-block SNR after fibre transmission varies significantly due to the variable-composition nature of modern probabilistic shaping schemes. We propose a nonlinearity-optimised distribution matcher that improves the average and worst-case SNR by 0.14 and 0.22 dB, respectively.

articleTitle: Quality of transmission estimation and performance prediction of lightpaths using machine learning
abstract: We show how the quality of transmission can be estimated before lightpath establishment using support vector machine and synthetic data and we illustrate how the long short term memory method can be used for performance prediction after lightpath establishment using field bit error rate data.

articleTitle: Neural turbo equalization to mitigate fiber nonlinearity
abstract: We propose a turbo equalization scheme based on deep neural networks (DNN) to compensate for fiber nonlinearity. The turbo DNN equalizer can accelerate decoding convergence and achieve a significant gain of about 2 dB in nonlinear regimes.

Index Terms: Output Of The Deep Neural Network

articleTitle: Noise mitigation of narrowband optical signals through lossless sampling
abstract: We demonstrate a method for denoising narrowband optical signals at the kHz and MHz level, outperforming typical narrowband filters. This scheme is robust to potential drifts affecting the central frequency of the signal to process and avoids the necessity to know precise parameters of said signal.

articleTitle: On the potential application space of multicore fibres in submarine cables
abstract: We examine the application space of uncoupled 4-core fibres in submarine cables with electrical power limitations. For a 24-fibre pair limit, the maximum MCF cable capacity gain can be up to 38% if fibre crosstalk is < −50 dB/km and fan-in/fan-out loss < 0.5 dB.

articleTitle: Real-time weakly-coupled mode division multiplexed transmission over 48 km 10-mode fibre
abstract: We show a real-time prototype optical coherent MIMO receiver for demultiplexing degenerate modes. With the receiver, we demonstrate real-time weakly-coupled 10-mode division multiplexed transmission of WDM DP-QPSK signals over 48 km.

Author Keywords: Demonstrations of transmission benefit from combined novel fibres

articleTitle: Fully passive user localisation for beam-steered high-capacity optical wireless communication system
abstract: Accurate device localisation within the 10cm pico-cell resolution of a 2D beam-steered optical wireless communication system is achieved by applying a large matrix of miniature corner-cube retro-reflectors. No power-consuming elements are needed at the receiver. Real-time transfer of multiple 10GbE video streams has been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Improvement of accuracy for measurement of 100-km fibre latency with Correlation OTDR
abstract: We measured the latency of a 100 km fibre link using a Correlation OTDR. Improvements over previous results were achieved by increasing the probe signal rate to 10 Gbit/s, using dispersion compensation gratings, and coupling the receiver time base to an external PPS signal.

articleTitle: Enhanced dispersion mapping for OPC-Aided transmission systems
abstract: We present a novel approach to designing transmission links with lumped amplification achieving near optimal nonlinearity compensation by inclusion of an inline OPC. SNR gains of 6.0 dB to 7.5 dB are found numerically in WDM multi-span transmission when comparing to standard EDFA-based systems.

articleTitle: P4-enabled Smart NIC: Architecture and technology enabling sliceable optical DCS
abstract: P4-enabled Smart NIC is implemented and demonstrated. Interconnect with optical BVT, it offers agile lOOGbps interface to transport P4-defined data path for L2/L3 from VMs to sliceable optical transport. The Smart NIC can achieve 84.8Gbps throughput; its hardware-enabled SR can produce 30% more bandwidth.

articleTitle: Leveraging blockchain to ratify QoT performance in multi-domain optical networks
abstract: We propose the use of blockchain for the ratification of QoT performance in multi-domain networks, where a transparent lightpath traverses several domains. End-to-end QoT is guaranteed by transferring “OSNR blocks” among domains' controllers. Experimental demonstration shows the feasibility of the method and its scalability.

articleTitle: Temperature dependent gain and noise figure characteristics of O-Band Bismuth-Doped fibre amplifier
abstract: We report an O-band BDFA gain and NF performance over the temperature-range of −40 to +60°C. A 34dB gain with 5.5dB NF was obtained at 1340nm in a double-pass-BDFA operating at −40°C. The temperature-dependent-gain was decreased by < 0.1dB/°C for temperatures above −20°C across 1310–1360nm wavelength-band.

articleTitle: Optical nonlinearity monitoring and launched power optimization by artificial neural networks
abstract: We present a linear-to-nonlinear power ratio monitor based on artificial neural networks and optical spectrum. The monitoring results are used to adjust the launch power providing up to 1 dB of signal-to-noise ratio gain in the ±3 dB region around the actual optimal power.

articleTitle: Narrowband photoreceiver for analog radio-over-fiber in the 24.25-29.5 GHz band
abstract: The presented narrowband photoreceiver, optimized for a 27.5-29.5 GHz Analog-RoF link, is based on a 3-stage GaAs narrowband low noise amplifier which offers 24.4-dB gain, 2.1-dB noise figure and 26.6-dBm OIP3. An rms-EVM of 2.46/3.47% is achieved for 100/400-MBaud 16-QAM over the 24.25-29.5 GHz band.

articleTitle: Optimized flexible mappings with multidimensional modulation for coherent optical transport
abstract: We vary the data rate in fine steps using flexible mappings with an optimized constellation shape with respect to the number of amplitude levels and power efficiency. The compatibility with established DSP algorithms is experimentally demonstrated over up to 568 km SSMF at 42 GBd.

articleTitle: Towards analogue Kramers-Kronig receivers
abstract: KK with analogue nonlinear processing could require less energy than DSP. We show the square-root can be replaced with a logarithmic diode. This approximation surprisingly gives performance advantages at low carrier levels, especially when using lower-extent clipping.

articleTitle: Reach extension of PAM4 signals in O-band transmission by application of alternate-mark-inversion
abstract: We improve the tolerance of O-band PAM4 transmission to nonlinearity by adopting an alternate-mark-inversion scheme. Improvements in receiver sensitivity are shown over both semiconductor optical amplifier and bismuth doped fibre amplifier equipped links, the greatest being a 4.4dB Q-factor improvement over 60km of SMF-28e.

articleTitle: Scattering efficiency of thermally excited GAWBS in fibres for optical communications
abstract: Simple formulas are proposed to quickly estimate the efficiency of thermally-excited guided acoustic wave Brillouin scattering in fibres for optical communications. The influence of the most important fibre parameters is shown, in particular the inverse dependence of the total scattering efficiency with the effective area.

articleTitle: Machine learning enhanced modulation format transparent carrier recovery based on high order statistics
abstract: A machine learning enhanced modulation transparent carrier recovery based on high order statistics is proposed and demonstrated with excellent linewidth tolerance. With the linewidth of 1MHz, 1.92-dB improvements in OSNR sensitivities for 28-GBd 16QAM at the BER threshold of 3.8 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup> is achieved successfully.

articleTitle: Short lattice-based shaping approach exploiting non-binary coded modulation
abstract: We study a lattice-based constellation shaping for high-order modulation exploiting non-binary forward error correction. It is demonstrated that the proposed lattice shaping combined with turbo trellis-coded modulation (TTCM) achieves about 0.5 dB gain over the conventional TTCM scheme.

Author Keywords: ADVANCED DATA ENCODING AND SIGNAL SHAPING

articleTitle: A linear photonic neuron using an extended IQ modulator cell for enabling all-optical coherent sigmoid neurons
abstract: We present a single-wavelength coherent linear neuron for allowing both weight amplitude and phase-encoded sign representation. All-optical algebraic summation operations are experimentally demonstrated, with simulation results for a trained all-optical 8-input coherent sigmoid neuron at 10Gb/s reveal an average accuracy of 94.37%.

articleTitle: 100 km 56 GBd PAM-4 transmission using photonic reservoir computing
abstract: Photonic reservoir computing allows shifting part of the signal processing to the optical domain. We compare the performance of reservoir computing-based estimation of data from a 56 GBd WDM transmission experiment over 100 km uncompensated SSMF with results from electronic DSP using Kramers-Kromg reception.

articleTitle: Fiber nonlinearity mitigation using optical phase conjugation based on inter-modal FWM
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an all-optical nonlinear-impairment mitigation by a mid-link optical phase conjugation based on inter-modal four-wave mixing in a 2-mode graded-index few-mode fiber. We transmit a single-channel 32-GBd single-polarization 16QAM signal over a dispersion-managed 800-km single-mode fiber link. Q<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>-factor improvement of ∼0.9 dB is achieved.

articleTitle: Novel DBA scheme integrated with SR- and CO-DBA for multi-service accommodation toward 5G beyond
abstract: We propose a novel dynamic bandwidth allocation (DBA) scheme that combines status-report and cooperative DBAs. Experiments show that the scheme can simultaneously realise low-latency transmission for time-critical service and high bandwidth utilization efficiency for other services with a commercial PON chip for the first time.

articleTitle: On-the-fly continuous time varying frequency filtering of broadband microwave signals
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a method for continuous user-defined time-varying frequency filtering of GHz-bandwidth microwave signals, offering reconfigurable speeds. This is achieved by manipulation of a time-mapped 2D spectrogram of the incoming waveform directly in the analog physical wave domain, using an intensity temporal modulator.

articleTitle: Increasing the modulated output power from an EML transmitter through a novel dual-drive scheme
abstract: A conventional EML is operated with a novel dual-drive scheme to increase output power before EAM saturation. At 10Gb/s, a 3dB power gain over conventional driving is measured with high extinction, good mask margin and low path penalty. Operation at 25Gb/s NRZ is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Machine-learning-based optical performance monitoring using carrier phase recovery
abstract: We demonstrate a simple machine-learning-based method to estimate the signal-to-noise ratio of an optical signal based solely on phase noise metrics that are readily extracted from a conventional carrier phase recovery algorithm. The method is then expanded to other impairments as well as BER estimation.

articleTitle: Bipolar pulse amplitude modulation with direct detection
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a novel transmission technique that employs bipolar pulse amplitude modulation (BPAM) and direct detection (DD). Compared to conventional IM/DD systems, the proposed BPAM/DD technique provides 4.5 dB OSNR gain and a good tolerance to group velocity dispersion with only a small additional complexity.

articleTitle: Absorption ratio dependence of gain characteristics on cladding pumped multicore EDFAs
abstract: We fabricate a 7-core EDF with absorption ratio of 2.5 dB/m at 1530 nm and measure EDF length dependence of gain characteristics. We confirm that products of absorption ratio and EDF length normalize output powers on cladding pumped multicore EDFAs regardless of absorption ratios.

articleTitle: Optical injection-locked high-speed heterogeneous quantum-dot microring lasers
abstract: We demonstrate < 6× modulation bandwidth extension of a heterogeneous quantum-dot microring laser using optical injection locking, obtaining 18 Gb/s on-off-keying modulation with clear open eyes. Single-mode lasing of all 11 longitudinal modes were achieved with <44 dB side-mode suppression and minimal 5 dB power increase.

articleTitle: First demonstration of mini-PON by using standard-based DBA-API and software components on commodity server apart from modular OLT
abstract: Mini-PON features a micro modular OLT and disaggregated software components that cooperatively work with OLT via standard-based APIs, thus enabling various small-scale broadband network services. Our demonstration shows that software DBA successfully runs on a commodity server remote from OLT via a standard-based DBA-API.

articleTitle: High data rate Tomlinson-Harashima-precoding-based PAM transmission
abstract: In this paper, we review the recent progress on Tomlinson-Harashima precoding (THP) scheme for high-performance PAM transmission using intensity modulation/direct detection systems. Based on an infinite impulse response filter at the transmitter, THP scheme improves the tolerance to spectral power fading and enables faster-than-Nyquist signaling.

articleTitle: EML transmitter as coherent monitor for distributed spectrum snooping
abstract: Awareness about the use of network assets and spectral resources in particular requires continuous and seamless monitoring throughout the network. Dense network architectures with high dynamicity in its highly populated links call for a distributed rather than a centralized approach so that the respective monitoring functionality should be integrated in all network terminals. In order not to introduce additional cost, we propose to re-use a transmitter that is widely adopted in direct-modulation / direct-detection systems as a spectral monitor. We experimentally demonstrate that an externally modulated laser is offering the functionality of a continuously tunable coherent receiver in order to down-convert optical signals to the RF domain for subsequent narrowband slicing and power integration. Modulation spectra for on-off keyed signals at different data rates and pulsed signals can be correctly acquired over a spectral range of 320 GHz, in virtue of the high resolution that the proposed coherent spectrum analyser is offering. The errors in wavelength and magnitude are less than 36 pm and 4.6 dB, respectively.

Author Keywords: Optical performance monitoring techniques and subsystems

articleTitle: Architectural foundation and control-plane integration of a novel metro-access, cloud-integrated, node
abstract: We propose a novel, cloud-integrated, Metro-Access node that is architected as a DataCentre, overcoming known Leaf-and-Spine limitations by exploiting PON systems and WDM for scalability. We demonstrate an SDN control-plane capable to rapidly instantiate connectivity resources within the node to interconnect intra-node servers with very low-latency.

articleTitle: Is the optical transport network of 5G ready for industry 4.0?
abstract: Industry 4.0 applications will require reliable, low-latency and jitter-free (deterministic) networks including an ultra-low packet loss rate. We will discuss relevant applications and their requirements and map them to appropriate transport networks either based on current or future based technologies.

articleTitle: Stokes vector spectroscopy of nonlinear depolarized light
abstract: Experimental Stokes vector spectroscopy characterizes polarization state noise in nonlinear fiber transmission. Noise bandwidths of a few MHz are observed from XPM-blurred receive SOPs using a polarization scrambling interferometer. This method can detect data pattern correlations among WDM channels that contribute to performance degradations in signalling.

articleTitle: A homodyne coherent receiver for analog-over-fibre systems based on feed-forward phase-noise cancellation
abstract: We introduce and then present the preliminary experimental characterization of a novel Coherent Receiver for Analog-over-Fiber systems featuring a feed-forward phase-recovery. Without using any digital phase estimation, the system allows to recover RF tones with SNR close to 50 dB with lasers exhibiting up to 100 MHz phase noise.

articleTitle: FPGA assisted design of concatenated LDPC convolutional and BCH codes for optical fiber communications
abstract: Employing FPGA emulations, we investigate effects of code length, girth, decoding buffer size on LDPC convolutional codes. We construct a 26.3% concatenated LDPC-convolutional and BCH code that approaches within 0.79 dB of the Shannon limit, a new record at 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−15</sup> BER with hardware-verification.

articleTitle: 800G/λ transponder based on joint subband processing and subcarrier multiplexing
abstract: We propose an 800-Gb/s transponder design based on joint sub-band processing and subcarrier multiplexing. To mitigate sub-band crosstalk without pre-calibration, we numerically demonstrate that a receiver-side 4×4 multi-input multi-output equalizer can be used with negligible penalty in the case of 14.1-dB single sideband suppression ratios.

articleTitle: Multi-dimensional probabilistic shaping for higher fibre nonlinearity tolerance
abstract: Probabilistic shaping (PS) modulation formats have large PAPR and may suffer higher nonlinear transmission penalty. In this paper, a multi-dimensional PS method has been proposed to mitigate nonlinear transmission penalty in 1D PS modulation format. Simulation results show a significant improvement over 1D PS modulation format.

articleTitle: Design optimization for energy-efficient pulse-switching networks in carrier-injection based Si-photonics
abstract: We compare pulse-switching operations in MZI- and ring-switches both experimentally and based on large-signal circuit simulations. With a modification in switch design and with optimization of phase modulator lengths, we show high-speed switches with potential for an over 3 dB improvement in energy consumption.

articleTitle: III-V-on-silicon widely tunable laser realized using micro-tranfer-printing
abstract: We present a C-band widely-tunable III-V-on-silicon laser (50 nm tuning, 5.2 dBm maximum power, 300 kHz minimum linewidth) realized through a micro-transfer-printing approach, in which III-V SOAs are pre-fabricated on a III-V substrate transferred using an elastomeric stamp to the silicon photonic circuit defining the laser cavity.

articleTitle: Silicon photonics comb demultiplexer for elastic optical networks
abstract: An integrated reconfigurable optical comb demultiplexer for flexible-grid optical networks is demonstrated using high-order distributed feedback resonators realized in silicon-on-insulator technology. Low-loss tone isolation of nearly 30dB for a comb spacing of 12.5GHz is experimentally demonstrated in an ultra-compact layout, with potentials for operation with finer grids.

articleTitle: Low power transceivers using low resolution DACs and optimized DSP
abstract: DSP techniques that enhance the effective resolution of DACs are presented. An improved digital-resolution-enhancer (DRE) algorithm is experimentally demonstrated, which incorporates an optimized non-uniform quantization scheme. Improvement of up to 8dB is shown, that enables 16QAM and 64QAM transmission using only 2 and 3 bits DACs respectively.

articleTitle: Long-haul mode multiplexing transmission enhanced by interference cancellation technique
abstract: We discuss transmission issues in achieving long-haul SDM transmission using mode division multiplexing (MDM). Key MDM transmission techniques that we have recently developed are also reviewed. Their applications for optical MDM transmission are experimentally investigated with linear filter adaptation techniques including the affine projection algorithm.

articleTitle: Experimental and theoretical analyses of GAWBS depolarization noise in digital coherent transmission
abstract: We present experimentally and analytically the intensity noise effect resulting from depolarization caused by guided acoustic-wave Brillouin scattering (GAWBS) in a digital coherent transmission. The TR2m GAWBS modes produce polarization-crosstalk of −42.3∼-37.9 dB in a 150∼160 km fibre, and this is detrimental to long-haul transmission.

articleTitle: Experimentally observed nonlinear depolarization of cw light in long-haul transmission
abstract: We report a novel transmission phenomenon in optical long-haul communication systems. Un-polarized ASE depolarizes via nonlinear fiber interactions a cw laser light during their co-propagation which results in small but measurable ultra-fast polarization state fluctuations at the fiber output.

articleTitle: Broadband photonic integrated multi-RF beamformer for K-band applications
abstract: An integrated-optics RF multi-beamformer network was designed, fabricated, and characterized. The beamforming chip demonstrates a wide 6 GHz delay bandwidth in the K-band, and can tune multiple RF beams independently of each other, over an angular scanning range of 90 degrees.

articleTitle: On the fairness of the performance evaluation of probabilistically shaped QAM
abstract: We discuss the fairness of the estimation of the impact of fiber nonlinearity and system gains of probabilistically shaped QAM systems depending on the reference achievable information rate, entropy and FEC rate.

articleTitle: Compact tap-isolator module using multicore fibre with practically low loss and small loss-variation
abstract: We developed a multicore tap-isolator fibre module (hybrid module of tap-monitor coupler and isolator) for the practical implementation in multicore EDFAs. We carefully investigated the cause of excess insertion loss and demonstrated a compact tap-isolator module with extremely low loss (0.74dB) and small loss-variation (0.18dB).

articleTitle: Abstraction and control of multi-domain disaggregated OpenROADM optical networks
abstract: In this paper, we experimentally validate a control plane architecture for multi-domain disaggregated transport networks that relies on the deployment of network elements compliant with the OpenROADM MSA device model. We demonstrate the abstraction and control of such networks in line with the ACTN framework.

articleTitle: Loss-less operation of membrane III-V semiconductor Mach-Zehnder modulator with optical amplifier on Si platform
abstract: 500-μm-long membrane InGaAsP-based Mach-Zehnder modulators (MZMs) and MQW-based semiconductor optical amplifiers (SOAs) are integrated by using regrowth techniques on Si platforms. The fibre-to-fibre loss-less condition achieves with 24-mA SOA bias. The MZM operates at a 10.8-dB extinction ratio with 4 V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">pp</inf> for 28-Gbit/s NRZ signals.

articleTitle: An extremely low-crosstalk WDM demultiplexer with an automatic error-correction capability enabling temperature insensitivity and high-yield integration on low-end Si PICs
abstract: We demonstrate a novel demultiplexer capable to resolve phase-error-induced impairments. With a simple control algorithm targeting integration, crosstalks of as low as −58 to −49 dB have been obtained. This technology enabling temperature insensitivity and high yields drastically improves performance and cost of WDM transceivers.

articleTitle: Quantum theory of noise in stokes vector receivers and application to bit error rate analysis
abstract: We develop a quantum theory of noise in the Stokes vector receiver. The Gaussian noise model for the shot noise and optical pre-amplifier noise is discussed. The bit error rate characteristics for the cubic polarization modulation format are calculated based on the Gaussian noise model.

articleTitle: OSNR prediction using machine learning-based EDFA models
abstract: We describe accurate neural network-type EDFA noise figure and gain models constructed using supervised learning. We demonstrate a key application of these models: accurate prediction of channel OSNR evolutions resulting from WDM add/drop operations.

articleTitle: Digital back propagation performance in spatial multiplexing systems
abstract: We review digital methods to mitigate the Kerr nonlinearity in multi-mode and/or multi-core fibres operating in different operational regimes as determined by differential mode delay and linear mode coupling. The results demonstrate that transmission performance can be more than doubled for feasible fibres characteristics.

articleTitle: PMD-tolerant direct detection in stokes space
abstract: Direct detection systems have been vulnerable to polarization mode dispersion (PMD). We propose using joint polarization recovery in Stokes and Jones space in a Stokes-vector receiver (SVR) with dual-polarization (DP) optical field recovery to achieve PMD immunity comparable to that of coherent receivers, verified by a 372-Gb/s DP 64-QAM SVR experiment.

articleTitle: Y-00 quantum stream cipher for physical layer security of optical communications
abstract: A Y-00 quantum stream cipher employing extremely high order modulation combines a mathematical cipher and physical randomness and provides high security to the physical layer of optical communications. The basic operation principle of a Y-00 cipher for data encryption is introduced, and experimental demonstrations using a Y-00 cipher are reported.

articleTitle: Multi-functional multi-core fibre based long-haul transmission system with lower DSP complexity
abstract: We propose a multi-function multi-core fibre (MF-MCF) based master-slave DSP system. We reveal that 5,000–10,000 km long full C-band WDM transmission with lower DSP complexity can be realized by controlling the optical time delay of the slave channels.

articleTitle: First demonstration of optical phase conjugation with real time commercial transceiver
abstract: We demonstrate the first experiment combining dual-band optical phase conjugation (OPC) and commercially available realtime transceivers in a 2×50km SSMF first-order Raman pumped link. The results show up to 6dB nonlinear threshold improvement in 100 Gb/s DP-QPSK 100km SSMF transmission using the dual-band OPC.

articleTitle: 50-Gbps PAM4 and electrical duobinary modulation with a lumped silicon photonic MZM
abstract: Simple pre- and post-compensation DSP is shown to efficiently enable 50-Gbps PAM4 and electrical duobinary modulation, with LR8 power budget and 10km of fibre, using a lumped silicon photonic MZM, which, being a capacitive load, presents a lower energy consumption compared to 50-Ω terminated modulators.

articleTitle: Uncooled 1.55μm electro-absorption modulated laser at 28Gb/s with high power and low Vpp for datacom
abstract: We present an uncooled 28Gb/s 1.55μm electro-absorption modulated laser, based on semi-insulating buried heterostructure waveguide technology. With only 0.9V peak-to-peak voltage, dynamic extinction ratio of more than 3.5dB, and facet average output power above 5dBm are demonstrated over the temperature range from 20 to 70°C.

articleTitle: Exploiting signal statistics in nonlinear digital signal proscessing
abstract: This paper discusses nonlinear noise caused by interfering channels in WDM system. The time-varying channel model is reviewed, and different mitigation techniques are discussed. The adaptive generalized filter is derived, and its performance is shown for trans-oceanic transmission distances.

articleTitle: Record single fibre unrepeatered transmission of 2 × 500 Gb/s over 405.7 km
abstract: We present the unrepeatered transmission of 2 × 500 Gb/s PDM-32QAM channels over 405.7 km of low-attenuation G.654 fibre, applying co-propagating Raman pumping at the transmitter end and a ROPA with third-order cascaded pumping at the receiver end.

articleTitle: Microwave photonics technologies for 5G and industry 4.0
abstract: The potential of Photonics for 5G and industry 4.0 development and deployment is addressed. The main applications and relative benefits of photonics for communication and sensing in these two scenarios are described. Finally recent achievements are presented.

Author Keywords: Microwave Photonics Subsystems Photonic Subsystems for dual use in RF systems i.e. communication and sensing

articleTitle: A compact WSS integrated by 1-f SPOC with dispersive metasurface and spectral interleaver
abstract: We propose a compact wavelength selective switch (WSS) integrated by 1-f spatial and planar optical circuit with metasurface-based high dispersive grating and spectral interleaver. As a prototype, we demonstrate 1×5 WSS supporting C+L-band with the footprint of 42×90 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Statistical evaluation of 4-Tb/s PAM4 DCI system with slope-compensating FBG-TDCM
abstract: We describe a 50-GHz channelized FBG-TDCM offering slope compensation over the full C-band which is suitable for DWDM PAM4 systems. We present comprehensive system performance results comprising 1,120 link measurements, with a novel statistical approach to account for variations in component characteristics and link impairments.

articleTitle: Silicon photonics wavelength-selective switch with contra-directional couplers
abstract: We propose a novel silicon photonics WSS with sidewall-corrugated contra-directional couplers which does not have an FSR and is suitable for broadband operation. A fabricated 2×2 single-channel WSS demonstrates the expected operation with an outband extinction of 30dB over a wavelength range wider than C-band.

articleTitle: Self-pumping saturated four wave mixing through harmonic synthesis
abstract: Through careful synthesis of four-wave mixing products, we are able to demonstrate self-pumping amplitude saturation with negligible amplitude to phase noise conversion requiring no additional pump lasers nor active SBS suppression.

articleTitle: Compact and low-power comb-locked transmitter based on ITLA tuneable lasers
abstract: We suggest and demonstrate a radically new approach to generate frequency-locked optical carriers. It provides for a low-power-consumption, self-starting and stable fibre comb operating across the entire C-band. We phase lock commercially-available Integrated-Tunable-Laser-Assembly (ITLA) lasers to the comb with arbitrary and fully tuneable spectral spacing.

articleTitle: Birefringent anti-resonant hollow-core fibre
abstract: We fabricated and characterised a birefringent anti-resonant hollow-core fibre. The birefringence was achieved by introducing different thickness resonators. The group birefringence was found to be 4.1×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−5</sup> at 1550 nm which relates to a 2.35×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−5</sup> phase birefringence. The attenuation of the fibre was 0.46 dB/m at 1550 nm.

articleTitle: Ultra-compact non-travelling-wave silicon Mach-Zehnder modulator
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate silicon non-traveling-wave-electrode Mach-Zehnder modulators (NTWE-MZM) utilizing carrier depletion that have record-small footprint (≤500μm×250μm) and comparable modulation efficiency to conventional TWE-MZM but using only 1/4∼1/2 phase shifter length, benefiting from no-RF-attenuation along electrode. 25Gb/s-NRZ-eye diagram and 13GHz-electro-optic bandwidth were confirmed under single-end driving.

articleTitle: Implications of polarization dependent loss on the performance of probabilistically shaped 64-QAM
abstract: The impact of polarization dependent loss (PDL) on the bit-wise achievable information rate is investigated for probabilistically shaped and uniform DP 64-QAM. The implications of the per-span PDL being uniformly distributed are assessed and the relationship between information rate and resilience to PDL is investigated.

Author Keywords: System level implications of physical impairments

articleTitle: PULSE: Scalable sub-μs WDM-TDM circuit switched data center network
abstract: We propose an OCS data center network and control system that uses distributed hardware schedulers to reconfigure circuits every 40ns. The network is scale-resilient to 8192 servers, achieving >92% sustained throughput, with low median (120ns) and tail (6.6μs) latencies, while consuming 415 pJ/bit.

articleTitle: Towards physical impairment aware software-defined partially disaggregated networks
abstract: Partially disaggregated networks require physical layer information to validate end-to-end characterization of WDM signals' integrity. Transport-API 2.1 includes the photonic-media layer characterization, enabling external wavelength provisioning over an Open Line System. This work presents the first proof-of-concept on a disaggregated multi-vendor testbed with TAPI 2.1.

articleTitle: Spectrally-efficient high-speed wireless bridge operating at 250 GHz
abstract: A photonic wireless bridge operating at 250 GHz is presented. Using a pilot tone-assisted phase noise compensation technique, a data rate of 40 Gbit/s is achieved using 16-quadrature amplitude modulation. Furthermore, the wireless bridge is also demonstrated in a wavelength division multiplexing scenario.

articleTitle: Experimental assessment of SDN-enabled sliceable OPSquare data center network with deterministic QoS
abstract: An SDN-enabled sliceable DCN with deterministic QoS guarantees is experimentally assessed. Flow priorities are dynamically assigned to each network-slice to prevent statistical latency and packet-loss due to packet retransmission. Deterministic network-slice achieves zero packet loss and bounded 804.5ns ToR-to-ToR latency without jitter for latency-sensitive applications.

articleTitle: III-V on SOI distributed feedback laser with very low frequency chirp for 10 Gb/s C-band access network
abstract: We report on a directly modulated III-V/Silicon C-band distributed feedback laser with a high quality factor design. This design has its chirp reduced, thus the reach of 10 Gbit/s directly modulated lasers was extended to 20 km with a dynamic extinction ratio of 7.9 dB.

articleTitle: Beyond 100 GBaud transmission supported by a 120 GSA/S CMOS digital to analog converter
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time a 105 GBaud coherent transmission using a CMOS digital to analog converter. Using variable probabilistically shaped constellations we obtain a maximal mutual information of 4.4 bit per symbol per polarization and demonstrate successful transmission beyond 800 Gb/s channel over 570 km.

articleTitle: FPGA implementation of distribution matching and dematching
abstract: We implemented distribution matching and dematching (DM/invDM) on an FPGA in a back-to-back configuration, for the first time demonstrating very low BERs. At a post-FEC BER of 1.5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−15</sup>, a BER after invDM of 1.6×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−14</sup> was measured.

articleTitle: Step-index profile multi-core fibre with standard 125 μm cladding to full-band application
abstract: We realize the step-index profile multi-core fibre (SI-MCF) with standard cladding which has fully compatible properties with SMF. Experimental results indicate full-band applicability of SI-MCF to >1 Tbit/s transmission with both parallel transmission and coherent transmission over several-tens km at 1260–1612 nm wavelength region.

Author Keywords: Multimode & multicore fibre and fibre amplifiers for spatial division multiplexing

articleTitle: Multi-user IFoF uplink transmission over a 32-element 60GHz phased array antenna enabling both Frequency and Spatial division multiplexing
abstract: We experimentally present the A-RoF/IFoF uplink transmission of three 60GHz terminals with 200Mb/s QPSK through a 32-element antenna with beamsteering up to a 60<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">o</sup>-angle and 10km fiber, comparing for the first time the frequency and spatial division multiplexing for multi-user uplink for 5G mmWave networks.

articleTitle: Revisiting multi-step nonlinearity compensation with machine learning
abstract: For the efficient compensation of fiber nonlinearity, one of the guiding principles appears to be: fewer steps are better and more efficient. We challenge this assumption and show that carefully designed multi-step approaches can lead to better performance-complexity trade-offs than their few-step counterparts.

articleTitle: 222-GBaud on-off keying transmitter using ultra-high-speed 2:1-selector and plasmonic modulator on silicon photonics
abstract: We demonstrate a 222-GBaud OOK optical transmitter for short-reach transmission, with direct detection after 120 m of standard single mode fiber. To reach this record symbol rate, we leverage a 2:1 digital multiplexing selector in InP DHBT and a plasmonic-organic hybrid (POH) modulator on silicon photonics.

articleTitle: Field trial of real-time single-carrier and dual-carrier 400G terrestrial long-haul transmission over G.654.E fiber
abstract: The world's longest terrestrial G.654.E fiber link with a total length of 1539.6 km is performed. Error-free transmission of real-time single-carrier and dual-carrier 400G over 603-km and 1058.9-km G.654.E fiber with an OSNR margin of more than 5 dB are demonstrated, respectively.

articleTitle: Dynamic crosstalk and skew on a 1.3 TB/S full-duplex O-band short reach transmission using an 8-core fiber
abstract: We demonstrate bidirectional >1.3Tb/s transmission on a 125 μm cladding 8-core MCF using 32GBaud 8-PAM signals on 4 cores/direction and evaluate the average and dynamic crosstalk and skew. These are shown to be well under the system requirements, despite the MCF's high spatial density.

articleTitle: GRPC-based SDN control and telemetry for soft-failure detection of spectral/spacial superchannels
abstract: This paper presents the first experimental demonstration of gRPC-based SDN control and telemetry architecture for spectral/spatial super-channels with SDM/WDM transceivers that monitor the BER to detect soft-failures over an 11-km 6-mode 19-core fiber. An evaluation of possible SDN protocols is provided for the discussed scenario.

Author Keywords: Integration of optical transmission and networks with higher layer network services

articleTitle: Power efficient transmission of 320 Gb/s over 17545 km, and 560 Gb/s over 6050 km using 98 GBd QPSK and 64QAM and CMOS technology
abstract: We demonstrate power efficient 320 Gb/s transmission over 17,545 km, and 560 Gb/s over 6,050 km, using 98 GBd PDMQPSK/64QAM and CMOS DAC technology, while applying digital and optical pre-emphasis. At the receiver side the standard digital signal processing is employed. nonlinear compensation was avoided.

articleTitle: Microbending behavior of randomly-coupled ultra-low-loss multi-core fiber
abstract: We studied microbending behavior of a randomly-coupled ultra-low-loss (0.155 dB/km) four-core fiber, and observed a negligible loss increase and 50%-reduction of spatial mode dispersion in the wire-mesh drum microbending test.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of neural network based demodulation for on-off encoded eigenvalue modulation
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an artificial neural network based demodulation for eigenvalue modulated signal with on-off encoding of four eigenvalues. We show a low error rate performance of BER < 3.8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup> at a bit rate of 2.5 Gb/s over 3,000 km transmission.

articleTitle: Real-time transmission of single-carrier 400 Gb/s and 600 Gb/s 64QAM over 200km-span link
abstract: We demonstrate real-time transmission of 24.6 Tb/s (41×600Gb/s) over 200 km across 32 nm bandwidth and 400 Gb/s in 50GHz grid over 2×200km using high-baud rate 64QAM modulation by a silicon photonics coherent transceiver.

articleTitle: TSV-assisted hybrid FinFET CMOS — Silicon Photonics Technology for high density optical I/O
abstract: We demonstrate ultra-compact, low-power 40 Gbps NRZ (single-lane) transmitter and receiver functionality in a hybrid 14 nm FinFET CMOS-silicon photonics (SiPh) interposer technology platform. The transceivers are fully powered and controlled through SiPh integrated TSVs and micro-bumps, paving the way for future ultra-dense multi-channel Tb/s co-packaged optics.

articleTitle: 200 Gbit/s net rate transmission over 2 km with a silicon photonic segmented MZM
abstract: We transmit 240 Gbit/s over 2 km below the 2.0E-02 Soft-Decision FEC threshold, using a single silicon photonic segmented-electrode MZM, 2.3 Vpp/segment and linear equalization only. This is the highest baudrate and first 200 Gbit/s net rate silicon modulator demonstrated in a IMDD system.

articleTitle: 100 Gbaud PAM4 link without EDFA and post-equalization for optical interconnects
abstract: We show 100 Gbaud PAM4 400 meters link with performance below the 7% HD-FEC limit of 5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup> without optical amplification and post-equalization. We also show 300 Gbps PAM8 line rate transmission over 400 meters of SSMF in C-band.

articleTitle: System demonstration of nanosecond wavelength switching with burst-mode PAM4 transceiver
abstract: We demonstrate a wavelength switching PIC whose switching time (0.912 ns) is independent of the tuning range, and an optical switching system (50Gbps PAM4) using the PIC and fast burst-mode channel equalization, achieving 3.84 ns switching latency.

articleTitle: The approaches of coherent technology for TDM-PON
abstract: Although commercial digital coherent receivers for core/metro networks are available, they do not provide a complete solution for access networks. This paper introduces approaches that have been proposed to customize coherent technology to TDMPON's specific requirements.

articleTitle: 402.7-Tb/s weakly-coupled 10-mode-multiplexed transmission using rate-adaptive PS PDM-16QAM WDM signals
abstract: We demonstrate a weakly-coupled 10-mode-multiplexed transmission with four 4×4 and two 2×2 MIMOs using rate-adaptive probabilistically-shaped (PS) PDM-16QAM signals over 48-km step-index few-mode fibre, achieving a record transmission capacity of 402.7 Tb/s in 125-μm cladding single-core fibre transmission experiments.

Author Keywords: Demonstrations of transmission benefit from combined novel fibres
Multimode & multicore fibre and fibre amplifiers for spatial division multiplexing

articleTitle: Comparison of uniform cross QAM and probabilistically shaped QAM formats under the impact of transmitter impairments
abstract: Considering the nonideal response of Mach-Zehnder modulators, uniform cross QAM constellations improve upon probabilistically shaped QAM by a factor of up to 4 in uncoded symbol error rate and also offer higher achievable information rates, at the same source entropy and optimal electrical signal powers.

articleTitle: 144-GBaud PDM-32QAM and 168-GBaud PDM-16QAM signal generation using ultra-broadband optical frontend module with digital pre-emphasis optimization
abstract: We successfully generated 144-GBaud PDM-32QAM and 168-GBaud PDM-16QAM signals with 1.14- and 1.19-Tbps/carrier net rates using analogue-multiplexer-based super-DAC scheme with in-house 80-GHz ultra-broadband optical frontend module. Digital pre-emphasis was optimized to reduce peak-to-average power ratio of low-speed signals from sub-DACs.

articleTitle: Experimental comparison of modulation formats for 200 G/λ IMDD data centre networks
abstract: We experimentally evaluate and compare the performance of IMDD modulation formats including duobinary PAM-4, PAM-6, trellis-coded two-dimensional PAM-8, and DMT for 200G per lambda data centre applications using commercial components. The achievable link budget, FEC and DSP requirement are major criteria for the evaluation.

articleTitle: Error-free 850nm to 1060nm VCSEL links: Feasibility of 400GBPS and 800GBPS 8λ-SWDM
abstract: We demonstrate effective transmitter equalization for 850nm, 980nm, and 1060nm VCSELs and 100m OM5 links enabling 78Gbps PAM-2 and <100Gbps PAM-4 100m error-free links. Extracted link penalties reveal net fibre dispersion and RIN enhancement create small to negligible power penalties for all wavelengths.

articleTitle: Real-time control for deterministic and dynamic networks
abstract: We propose a dynamic control system for deterministic networks and demonstrate complete network reconfiguration in less than 20μs through a few km long network while guaranteeing deterministic latency. We introduce a novel real-time controller using FPGA and implemented in an all-optical data centre network testbed.

articleTitle: Hybrid O-band electro-absorption modulators on multi-micron waveguide silicon photonics platform for optical engine applications
abstract: We demonstrate a silicon photonics hybrid O-band electro-absorption modulator in a multi-micron waveguide platform. Modulation is achieved in the InP-based devices with a U-bend ridge-waveguide configuration for single-sided coupling to the silicon chip. 106Gb/s PAM-4 performance at varying temperatures up to 70C is demonstrated.

articleTitle: 107.1-Gbps net-rate transmission over a joint 51km-fibre-and-10.7m-wireless link for terahertz radio access networks
abstract: 107.1 and 93.9-Gbps net-rate (gross-rate 133.9 and 101.3-Gbps) OFDM transmission on a 408-GHz carrier frequency is experimentally demonstrated over a joint fibre-wireless link, 51-km single-mode fibre and 10.7-m free-space, with bit-error-rates below the 20% soft- and 7% hard-decision FEC thresholds of 2.7×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−2</sup> and 3.8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup>, respectively.

articleTitle: Multieigenvalue communication paired with b-modulation
abstract: We introduce the optical communication system based on nonlinear Fourier transform (NFT), where we combine the b-modulation technique, facilitating control over the signal duration, with multieigenvalue communication comprising the modulation of phase, to reach the 10% higher achievable data rate.

articleTitle: Beyond 100-Gb/s/λ direct-detection transmission over the S+C+L-bands in an ultra-wide bandwidth hollow core fibre
abstract: We report beyond 100-Gb/s/λ adaptively-loaded discrete multitone (DMT) transmission over the S+C+L-bands using an ultra-wide bandwidth hollow-core Nested Antiresonant Modeless Fibre (NANF) with a low polarisation dependent loss. The results show up to 132.8-Gb/s penalty-free transmission over ∼lkm fibre length without optical amplification.

articleTitle: Flexible 50G PON based on multi-rate PAM and CAP-4 with user interleaving
abstract: We investigated flexible 50G TDM-PON based on multi-rate carrierless-amplitude-phase modulation and pulse-amplitudemodulation, featuring user interleaving in one time-slot. The flexibility can be used to optimize PON resource usage, we estimate a throughput increase of ∼30% for both schemes relative to a fixed PON for a typical installation.

articleTitle: LUT-assisted pre-compensation for 225 Gb/s/λ O-band transmission
abstract: A two-step approach to pre-compensate the linear and nonlinear distortions in an IM/DD transceiver is introduced. A comparison with conventional Volterra post-equalization is presented. The proposed method significantly improves performance and enables the transmission of net 200 Gb/s per carrier over 2 km (O-band) link.

articleTitle: Optical time-slot switching with 5-μs guard time using 32×32 Si to PILOSS switch
abstract: We demonstrate dynamic optical circuit switching using a 32×32 Si thermo-optic strictly-non-blocking switch for optical flow control in datacentre networks. Switching is accelerated by rapid heating in pulse-width-modulation control, and four synchronized optical time slots are switched within the guard time of 5 μs.

articleTitle: 120Gbit/s multi-mode fiber transmission realized with feed forward equalization using 28GHz 850nm VCSELs
abstract: This work presents a new generation of ultra-wideband VCSELs. They achieve a bandwidth of up to 28GHz with high linearity, enabling error-free 80Gbit/s PAM-4 transmission using 6tap transmit FFE equalization and up to 120Gbit/s PAM-4 with an additional 5tap FFE in the receiver.

articleTitle: Generalized Kramers-Kronig receiver for 16QAM wireless THz transmission at 110 Gbit/s
abstract: We demonstrate wireless THz transmission of 16QAM signals using a Schottky barrier diode receiver in combination with generalized Kramers-Kronig signal processing. We achieve a record-high net data rate of 110 Gbit/s over a transmission distance of 110 m.

articleTitle: Quantum technologies in support for 5G services: Ordered proof-of-transit
abstract: This work presents a method for supporting traffic attestation (ordered proof-of-transit) in service chaining and other traffic flows that uses cryptographic algorithms in combination with quantum technologies (QKD, QRNG). This capability is implemented over the production Madrid Quantum Network facilities.

articleTitle: High-capacity and rain-resilient free-space optics link enabled by time-adaptive probabilistic shaping
abstract: Using time-adaptive probabilistic shaped 64QAM driven by a simple SNR prediction algorithm, we demonstrate >450 Gbps transmission over a 55-m free-space optics link with enhanced resilience towards rainy weather conditions. Through continuous measurement over 3-hours, we demonstrate ∼40 Gbps average bit-rate gain over unsupervised fixed modulation.

articleTitle: Monolithic high-speed transmitter enabled by BiCMOS-plasmonic platform
abstract: A monolithic BiCMOS-plasmonic transmitter offering 120 GBd NRZ-OOK is demonstrated. The chip comprises an electronic-photonic layer stack. The SiGe BiCMOS electrical layers offer PRBS generation and 4:1 power multiplexing, while the plasmonic layer offers electro-optical modulation at highest speed.

articleTitle: Node architecture and design of spatially jointed flexible waveband routing optical networks
abstract: A novel node architecture for spatial-division-multiplexing networks that adopts spatially jointed flexible optical path grouping followed by core-wise path group switching is proposed. Numerical experiments elucidate that almost ideal routing performance is realized while reducing WSS number by up to 54-73 %.

articleTitle: 2-Channels × 100 GBd 32QAM transmission over 500 km enabled by InP PICs and SiGe ASICs
abstract: We show 100 GBd 32QAM transmission enabled by hybrid integration of InP PICs featuring 40 kHz linewidth widely tunable lasers and SiGe electronics. A mean Q-factor of 6.2 dB after 500 km transmission is measured, demonstrating the feasibility of 800 Gbit/s waves for extended-reach applications.

articleTitle: Considerations on transport latency in passive optical networks
abstract: Deterministic, ultra-low latency and low jitter communication is becoming an important requirement on future access networks. PONs are known to be a resource efficient and low cost technology for optical access. Their operation, however, needs rethinking to comply with future time-sensitive network applications.

articleTitle: 600G PAM4 transmission using a 4-lambda CWDM TOSA based on controlled-ISI pulse shaping and Tomlinson-Harashima precoding
abstract: We demonstrate a high capacity PAM4 transmission over 2 km using a 4-λ CWDM TOSA. A net rate of 605.6 Gb/s excluding 7% hard-decision FEC overhead is achieved using transmitter-side controlled-ISI pulse shaping, Tomlinson-Harashima precoding and receiver-side linear equalizer.

articleTitle: Cladding pump recycling using cascaded pump collectors in 7-core EDFA
abstract: We demonstrate a cladding pumped 7-core EDFA with 1.6dB increased output power by recycling the cladding pumping light collected by the cascaded pump collector to the pump combiner. The power consumption is reduced by 30% under the same output power condition.

articleTitle: On the impact of IT resources disaggregation in optically interconnected data centres
abstract: Resource disaggregation-based DCs may face severe performance degradations for VM-to-VM communications due to their impact on network utilization. We analyse this phenomenon and investigate how it relates to blade and/or network resource dimensioning for a proper compensation of the effect.

articleTitle: Directly modulated photonic integrated multi-section laser for next generation TWDM access networks
abstract: A multi-section laser PIC for use as a directly modulated transmitter is demonstrated. The unique architecture of the chip, employing a master-slave configuration, delivers chirp reduction and enables error-free transmission of 10 Gb/s on-off keyed signal over 37 km of single-mode fiber.

articleTitle: Characterisation of novel polarisation-insensitive configurations of fibre optical parametric amplifiers
abstract: We experimentally compare two novel polarisation-insensitive fibre optical parametric amplifiers configurations by amplifying 35GBaud PDM-QPSK signal in WDM environment and measuring BER. We demonstrate that one configuration provides 1dB better Q<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> in linear regime, while another improves Q<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> by up to 4dB in nonlinear regime.

articleTitle: Joint VNF and multi-layer resource allocation with an open-source optimization-as-a-service integration
abstract: The open-source planning tool Net2Plan provides a network Optimization-as-a-Service system to assist Open-Source MANO and WAN Infrastructure Manager(s) with the joint computation of multi-site VNF placement and multi-layer resource allocation in the deployment of a network service in a metro network.

articleTitle: Millimeter wave beamsteering with true time delayed integrated optical beamforming network
abstract: A W-band millimeter-wave 1 × 4 phased array antenna with true time delayed integrated optical beamforming network was demonstrated for the first time. Steering angles of −51°, −33°, −16°, −2°, 14° and 31° were achieved with excellent beam quality.

articleTitle: Ultimate capacity limit of a multi-span link with phase-insensitive amplification
abstract: The Shannon capacity of a point-to-point link with an optimised configuration of optical amplifiers is compared with general detection strategies permitted by quantum mechanics. Results suggest that the primary application area of receivers based on such strategies may be unamplified short-distance links or free-space optical communication.

articleTitle: Experimental characterization of equalization-enhanced phase noise in transoceanic transmission systems
abstract: We performed a multi-parameter campaign of measurements of 34-90 GBd, PDM-QPSK and 8QAM channels transmitted over up to 10,476km links, and tested different types of lasers with different linewidths (from <1-KHz to >100-kHz) to experimentally determine the impact of equalization-enhanced phase noise in submarine transmission systems.

articleTitle: 220 Gbit/s optical PAM4 modulation based on lithium niobate on insulator modulator
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate ultra-high speed optical modulations up to 120 Gbit/s (120 Gbaud NRZ) and 220 Gbit/s (110 Gbaud PAM4) based on a lithium niobate on insulator (LNOI) modulator, which has a 3-dB electro-optical bandwidth of 56 GHz and the V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</inf> of 2.6 V.

articleTitle: An 8-core erbium-doped fiber with annular doping for low gain compression in cladding-pumped amplifiers
abstract: We design, simulate and characterize an 8-core cladding-pumped EDFA with annular doping. Gain compression <1.8 dB and minimum gain >12.2 dB over the C-band are demonstrated when the total input power varies between −23.1 dBm and 1.4 dBm

articleTitle: Silicon-contacted waveguide integrated Ge/Si avalanche photodiode with 32 GHz bandwidth and multiplication gain > 8
abstract: We report a waveguide integrated Ge/Si avalanche photodiode with primary responsivity of 0.78 A/W, multiplication gain >8 and a bandwidth of 32 GHz at −12 V. Wide-open eye diagrams are obtained at 8.5 multiplication gain for 25, 40 and 50 Gbps NRZ-OOK data rates.

articleTitle: Machine-learning aided OSNR prediction in optical line systems
abstract: We suppose an OLS agnostic operation by relying only on the OCM telemetry. Analyzing an experimental data-set from an 11 EDFA OLS, we show the need for 3.6 dB margin without knowledge on EDFAs, reduced to 0.4 dB by DNN machine learning.

articleTitle: Long-haul transmission of WDM signals with in-line phase-sensitive amplifiers
abstract: We demonstrate the use of in-line low-noise phase-sensitive amplifiers (PSAs) in a wavelength-division multiplexing long-haul transmission link with a recirculating loop experiment. We quantify how replacing phase-insensitive amplifiers with PSAs can improve the reach of one-, two-, and three-channel transmission systems both numerically and experimentally.

articleTitle: Ftth and optical LAN synergy enabled by virtual OLT for home, office and campus
abstract: We demonstrate the capacity of passive optical network technologies to meet home LAN and passive optical LAN requirements thanks to virtual and chained OLTs that are hardware agnostic and can be managed by both the final user and the network service provider.

articleTitle: A silicon microwave photonic down-converter
abstract: Using a commercial foundry platform, we experimentally demonstrate the first silicon photonic down-converter with electrical intermediate frequency conversion fully on-chip and identify performance scaling with evolving foundry capabilities. The subsystem demonstrates 11.2 GHz bandwidth, −19.5 dB gain, and a spur-free dynamic range of 92 dB·Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2/3</sup>.

articleTitle: Full-field, carrier-less, polarization-diversity, direct detection receiver based on phase retrieval
abstract: We realize dual-polarization full-field recovery using intensity only measurements and phase retrieval techniques based on dispersive elements. 30-Gbaud QPSK waveforms are transmitted over 520-km standard single-mode fiber and equalized from the receiver outputs using 2×2 MIMO.

articleTitle: Soft failure identification in optical networks based on convolutional neural network
abstract: A convolutional neural network (CNN) based soft failure identifier is proposed. Its superior performance in identifying failure causes including filter shift, filter tightening, ASE noise and nonlinear interference is demonstrated. And its robustness in the scenario with multiple impairment deteriorations is also validated.

articleTitle: Optimization of two-stage carrier phase estimation for probabilistic shaping
abstract: The impact of probabilistic shaping (PS) on two-stage carrier phase estimation employing the blind phase search (BPS) and constellation transformation (CT) algorithms is investigated for PS-64QAM systems. With adequate adaption of BPS to the shaping, a single implementation of CT achieves shaping gains comparable to two-stage BPS.

Author Keywords: Reduced complexity carrier phase estimation in optical transmission systems

articleTitle: Demonstration of real-time filter fault identification and localization using dual-band pilot tone detection enabled by an ASIC chip
abstract: We demonstrate distributed and real-time monitoring of filter faults using dual-band pilot tone detection on a compact ASIC. The frequency offset between the signal carrier and optical filter can be detected with a sensitivity of better than 1 GHz.

articleTitle: 4-Channel Bi-doped fibre amplifier
abstract: Here, for the first time to the best of our knowledge, we demonstrate multi-channel Bi-doped fibre amplifier. The 4-channel amplifier (1.43, 1.45, 1.47 and 1.49 μm central wavelengths) comprised 320-m long piece of a Bi-doped fibre diode-pumped at 1.305 μm with maximal pump power of 450 mW. The maximum gain reached 27.8 dB at 1.43 μm.

articleTitle: Flexible resource provisioning of coherent PONs based on Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access and CAP signals
abstract: Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access (NOMA) technique and Carrierless Amplitude Phase (CAP) modulation have been used to demonstrate pay-as-you-grow coherent Passive Optical Networks (PON) and providing a 10 Gbps aggregate data rate.

articleTitle: Exact nonlinear frequency division multiplexing in lossy fibers
abstract: The path-average approximation penalizes NFDM transmission over lumped amplified fiber links. We investigate suitably tapered lossy fibers to overcome the approximation error induced by the path average, making the NFDM transmission exact. Error vector magnitude gains up to 4.8 dB are observed.

Author Keywords: Demonstrations of transmission benefit from combined novel fibres

articleTitle: A radar-over-fiber system based on directly-modulated uncooled VCSELs
abstract: A radar system with transmitter/receiver remoting through VCSEL-based optical links has been experimentally realized for the first time. Direct modulation of uncooled VCSEL packages guarantees good linearity. 120dB-power budget, dynamic range >70dB and indoor target detection through low-cost patch antennas have been demonstrated.

articleTitle: 16×16 Silicon photonic switch with nanosecond switch time and low-crosstalk architecture
abstract: A nanosecond silicon photonic 16×16 switch was built, to reduce power consumption of Petabit routers. Tested lightpaths had −33 dB crosstalk over 40 nm bandwidth, implementing a novel crosstalk-suppression architecture. A duplicate chip was built with SiN overpass crossings, which can further reduce crosstalk to −40dB.

articleTitle: MIMO-free WDM-MDM transmission over 100-km single-span ring-core fibre
abstract: Based on a specially designed ring-core fibre with 0.2-dB/km fibre attenuation, 100-km single-span transmission of two orbital-angular-momentum mode groups each carrying 4 wavelengths is successfully demonstrated without using MIMO equalization.

articleTitle: First demonstration of ultra-long-distance mode-division multiplexing transmission using orbital angular momentum (OAM) modes over 150-km low-loss ring-core fiber without amplifiers
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the first record long-single-span orbital angular momentum (OAM) multiplexing transmission assisted by all-fiber OAM (de)multiplexer. Two OAM modes, each carrying a 20-Gbit/s QPSK signal, are successfully (de)multiplexed and transmitted over 150-km low-loss ring-core fiber (RCF) without using MIMO-DSP and amplifiers

articleTitle: Fibre model identification for nonlinear Fourier transform-based transmission
abstract: Fibre-optic transceivers based on nonlinear Fourier transforms approximate the link by a lossless path-average model. We propose a new method that identifies a suitable lossless model from time-domain input-output data when fibre parameters are unknown. No special training signals are needed.

articleTitle: Dual O+C-band WDM transmission over 1-km hollow core NANF using an O-band bismuth-doped fibre amplifier
abstract: Amplified transmission of WDM channels over the O- and C-bands is demonstrated using a bismuth-doped fibre amplifier. The transmission medium is an ultra-wide bandwidth nested antiresonant fibre (NANF) offering uniform loss performance across all wavelengths of interest. Comparable performance is obtained across the two bands.

articleTitle: Demonstration of reflection-tolerant RoF-based mobile fronthaul network for 5G wireless system
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a reflection-tolerant RoF-based mobile fronthaul network for the 5G wireless system by using the Gaussian phase dither technique. In this demonstration, we transmit 128 100-MHz OFDM signals modulated in 256QAM format under the influence of multiple reflectors.

articleTitle: Optical frequency comb modulator for multichannel systems
abstract: We demonstrate a full-field modulator for encoding independent waveforms onto wavelength separated inputs without demultiplexing. The modulator uses phase-only modulation and dispersive filtering for temporal reshaping and has no theoretical losses. Simultaneous modulation of three wavelengths with independent random 1% roll-off data patterns is experimentally verified.

articleTitle: Digital frequency/phase offset correction for 60 GHz OFDM radio-over-fibre with unlocked fibre lasers
abstract: Analog radio-over-fibre transmission is hindered by its sensitivity to frequency and phase fluctuations. This work presents a hybrid approach through digital frequency and phase offset estimation/correction, enabling optical heterodyne transmission of 60 GHz OFDM over 25km of fibre using two unlocked fibre lasers.

articleTitle: Real-time discrete multi-tone transmission for passive optical networks in C- and O-band
abstract: DMT at 25 Gbit/s, 50 Gbit/s and 100 Gbit/s in passive systems with electro-absorption modulators is investigated. Transmission in C- and O-band are compared, yielding up to 22 km reach, 100 Gbit/s in O-band. All results are obtained with a real-time signal processing ASIC.

articleTitle: Field demonstration of 25G-PON and XGS-PON burst-mode upstream coexistence
abstract: We perform a field demonstration of 25 Gb/s burst-mode upstream duobinary transmission in O-band using 10G optoelectronics and APD-based optical receiver with memory-aided adaptive equalization, coexisting with XGS-PON transmission. We achieve 31 dB ODN loss budget and show marginal interference penalty between the two systems.

articleTitle: 24 GBd DP-QPSK upstream and downstream operation of a colourless coherent PON using an MLLD-based frequency comb
abstract: We propose and study a colourless coherent TDM PON architecture which does not require precise wavelength matching between the lasers in the ONUs and in the OLT. We experimentally demonstrate 83.5 Gbit/s upstream and downstream operation with a wavelength variation of up to +4 nm.

articleTitle: Photonic-assisted analog-to-digital conversion using integrated soliton microcombs
abstract: We demonstrate a system using Silicon Nitride-based integrated Kerr frequency combs to enhance the ultrafast digitization of large bandwidth signals. A dual-comb architecture is used to realize a broadband photonic channelization of the incoming RF spectral content. High frequency signals up to 40 GHz are detected with 6 ENOB.

articleTitle: 36 Gb/s operation of a BiCMOS driver and InP EAM using foundry platforms
abstract: We demonstrate a clear eye-diagram at 36 Gb/s of a BiCMOS driver directly wire-bonded to an InP electro-absorption modulator (EAM) both fabricated through foundry platforms. The driver is fabricated in a 0.25 urn SiGe:C BiCMOS technology and delivers a maximum of 2 V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p-p</inf> amplitude when single-ended. The driver is DC-coupled to the modulator, simplifying the electronic-photonic assembly. The EAM operates in the L-band at 1590 nm, with a DC bias set at −1.6 V for on-off keying nonreturn to zero modulation. We measure the operation from 10 to 40 Gb/s, recording the dynamic extinction ratio from 5 to 3 dB, respectively. The use of foundry platforms does not require any fabrication process change and offers a wide spectrum of high-performance photonic-electronic integrated circuits.

articleTitle: Dual-polarization Kramers-Kronig reception using two collinear polarization-selective photodiodes
